edition.title: Oxylabs Web API (Bearer key; not the Classic product)

replaced_lines.core: provider: scrapedo             # the run's page provider: scrapedo | oxylabs (the Oxylabs Web API, Bearer key;
replaced_lines.edition: provider: oxylabs              # the run's page provider: scrapedo | oxylabs (the Oxylabs Web API, Bearer key;

changes.diff:
--- core/.env.example
+++ oxylabs/.env.example
@@ -1,25 +1,23 @@
-# walmart-azure-headless: environment for a local run (copy to .env, never commit .env).
-# In Azure these are set on the job; the secrets are Key Vault references (see docs/AZURE.md).
+# walmart-azure-headless, Oxylabs Web API edition: environment for a local run (copy to .env, never commit
+# .env). The edition runs the Oxylabs Web API only (docs/EDITIONS.md): it needs no Scrape.do key and refuses
+# a Scrape.do run. In Azure these are set on the job; the secrets are Key Vault references (see docs/AZURE.md).
 
-# PostgreSQL (psycopg). A password may be in the URL or in PGPASSWORD.
-WALMART_COLLECTOR_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://walmart_collector@localhost:5432/walmart_collector
+# PostgreSQL (psycopg): a database of this edition's own, never the other edition's. A password may be in the
+# URL or in PGPASSWORD.
+WALMART_COLLECTOR_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://walmart_collector@localhost:5432/walmart_oxylabs
 # PGPASSWORD=
 # entra = Azure Database for PostgreSQL with the job's managed identity (no password)
 # WALMART_COLLECTOR_DATABASE_AUTH=entra
 
-# Scrape.do: the key itself, or a file holding it (an Azure secret volume)
-SCRAPEDO_API_KEY=
-# SCRAPEDO_API_KEY_FILE=/mnt/secrets/scrapedo-api-key
-
-# Oxylabs Web API, for a store whose provider is oxylabs: its Bearer key itself, or a file holding it. Not
-# credentials of the Oxylabs Classic product. Each edition (editions/) names its own provider's key only.
-# OXYLABS_WEB_API_KEY=
+# Oxylabs Web API: its Bearer key itself, or a file holding it (an Azure secret volume). Not credentials of
+# the Oxylabs Classic product. Nothing is sent before `set-ceiling --provider oxylabs` (docs/CLI.md).
+OXYLABS_WEB_API_KEY=
 # OXYLABS_WEB_API_KEY_FILE=/mnt/secrets/oxylabs-web-api-key
 
-# Configuration and storage
+# Configuration and storage: a data folder (or blob container) of this edition's own
 WALMART_COLLECTOR_CONFIG=config/collector.yaml
+WALMART_COLLECTOR_DATA_DIR=./data
 # WALMART_COLLECTOR_STORAGE=azure_blob
 # WALMART_COLLECTOR_BLOB_ACCOUNT_URL=https://<account>.blob.core.windows.net
-# WALMART_COLLECTOR_BLOB_CONTAINER=walmart-collector
-# WALMART_COLLECTOR_DATA_DIR=./data
+# WALMART_COLLECTOR_BLOB_CONTAINER=walmart-collector-oxylabs
 # WALMART_COLLECTOR_LOG_LEVEL=INFO

edition.note: the revision's own files but for the changes listed; the other edition of the release is built from the same revision
